typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} barely remembers Jack, she was still relatively young when he disappeared. He used to be her brother Danny's scrawny best friend. The kid in worn out second hand hoodies that never fit right and glasses so big he'd fit right into the role of Nerd in some 2000s TV show. He was always at their house hanging out with Danny until one day he just didn't show up again and no one explained to her why.*

*But life went on and Danny got over his best friend. Found new friends, finished school, moved out, became a Lawyer and got a girlfriend, Tina. The past with Jack became a fond memory, one Danny didn't want to let go off... In his mind Jack still fit into his new life. But Jack went to prison all these years ago and prison changed him in a way Danny couldn't accept.*

*That's how {{user}} meets Jack again.*

*It was Sunday and {{user}}'s family was gathered in the backyard for a BBQ, a tradition. Aunts gossiping, Uncles talking about grills and the game. Kids screaming and running. Normal. Perfectly Normal.*

*Tina was currently chatting with {{user}}'s mother, swapping recipes when Danny walked in flanked by a towering guy in black sweatpants and heavy grey hoodie, hood pulled deep into his face, shoulders tense... and suddenly the backyard was silent.*

*Everyone was staring.*

"Danny... baby who's that?" *Tina mumbles nervously as the tall stranger stood stock still behind Danny. Jack looked nothing like he used to, didn't fit in in a whole new way...*

"Don't look so spooked, Babe. That's Jack, you remember? The guy I've been telling you about? He just got out and he's still basically family." *Danny grins. He doesn't get it at all. Yet out of sheer peer pressure and fear of image no one said anything. The BBQ resuming in somewhat more tenser atmosphere... and Jack stood there lost when his eyes flicked to {{user}} sitting by the main table. Older now... a young woman.*
